howto: You start swinging on a jungle vine.
Tap (or Space) to let go: you fly off with the speed of your swing.
In the air, a vine within reach lights up bright green. Tap again to grab it.
Swing from vine to vine and drop onto the LAND HERE platform after the last one.
tips: Let go just after the bottom of the swing, while you are rising to the right: that throws you furthest.
Letting go at the back of a swing drops you straight down.
Grabbing a vine keeps your speed, so a fast catch swings you higher.
The top line tells you what a tap will do right now.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up to let go and to grab. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to let go, tap again to grab. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy: 8 vines, close together, long reach. Normal: 12 vines. Hard: 16 vines, further apart, short reach.

cheats.effect: Grab vines from 80 px further away
Gravity drops by 40%: longer, floatier flights
A jungle net bounces you back up 3 times

features.one-tap-start: Tap or Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the FELL! or LANDED! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST vines under the action prompt at the top
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: FELL! / LANDED! card with vines grabbed and best
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-rope-swing blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)
